title: Sprite Library: 61 Pixel Art Sprite Packs (Characters, Monsters, VFX) + Every New One
short_text: 61 pixel art sprite packs in one download, every new pack added free
description:
61 CSAF sprite packs in one download, worth $463.39 bought one by one, with Godot 4 SpriteFrames in 50 packs and RPG Maker MZ sheets in 41, for $19.99.

Buy once, keep every pack that joins. The price rises as the library grows.

How the future packs work

  • When a new CSAF sprite pack comes out, its files are added to this page on launch day.
  • You do not pay again. Open your itch.io library and the new files are there.
  • Every addition gets a devlog post here, so follow the page to hear about it.

Latest additions

  • 2026-11-10: Handheld 01 joins with 12,902 PNG frames and sheets. New here first: it has no page of its own yet.
  • 2026-11-10: Emberwrit Skill Sets joins with 40 pixel battle skills for RPG Maker MZ: 1,282 PNG frames and sheets at 96x96 and 48x48 and 32x32. New here first: it has no page of its own yet.
  • five earlier additions, each with its own devlog post below.
  • 2026-11-06: the Library opens with 54 packs, 61,992 PNG frames and sheets.

What's inside (61 packs)

Wildmark: fantasy heroes, their action sets, held items and MZ battlers (8 packs, $61.92 one by one): Handheld 01 (new here first), Wildmark 01, Wildmark 03, Wildmark 04, Wildmark Actions 02, Wildmark Actions 03, Wildmark Actions 04, Wildmark Battlers.

Hearthhands: villagers, townsfolk and their portraits (8 packs, $60.92 one by one): Hearthhands 01, Hearthhands 02, Hearthhands 03, Hearthhands 04, Hearthhands 05, Hearthhands Hallowtide, Hearthhands Portraits, Hearthhands Side.

Mourncrest: undead, grave goods and portraits (7 packs, $41.93 one by one): Mourncrest 02, Mourncrest 03, Mourncrest 04, Mourncrest 05, Mourncrest Portraits, Mourncrest Reforged 01, Mourncrest Reforged.

Kithfell: companions, pets, beasts and MZ battlers (6 packs, $46.94 one by one): Kithfell 01, Kithfell 02 Actions, Kithfell 02, Kithfell 03, Kithfell Companions, Kithfell Pet Shop.

Deepwarren: monsters with full combat sets and MZ battlers (4 packs, $33.96 one by one): Deepwarren 01, Deepwarren 02 (this page was its page), Deepwarren Battlers, Deepwarren Side.

Dreadmark: side-view bosses, eight states each, hit-flash and phase-2 sheets (1 pack, $14.99 one by one): Dreadmark (new here first).

Farmstead: livestock and farm animals (4 packs, $27.96 one by one): Farmstead 01 Actions, Farmstead 01, Farmstead 02, Farmstead 03.

Kept Year Faces: RPG dialogue portraits, five expressions each (1 pack, $7.99 one by one): Kept Year Faces (new here first).

Kept Year Cast: top-down field sprites of the same village, four facings (1 pack, $7.99 one by one): Kept Year Cast (new here first).

More casts: modern, cyberpunk, pirate, goblin, monster and creature-partner rosters (7 packs, $57.93 one by one): Bestiary, Brinemark, Greenskin 01, Neonward 01, Neonward, Pocketfolk 01, Streetlight 01.

Travel, wildlife and nature: travellers, carts and boats, birds, fish, trees and flora (6 packs, $46.94 one by one): Cart & Keel, Grovekeep 01, Skyfoundling 01, Tidewell 02 (new here first), Tidewell, Wayfarer 01.

VFX, ability icons and pixel fonts (8 packs, $53.92 one by one): Emberwrit 01, Emberwrit Skill Sets (new here first), Lantern & Tallow, Pixel Font Pairs Vol. 1 (new here first), Shroud & Sallow, Sigilcast 01, Sparkfall 01, Sparkfall 02.

Held back from this first build while a repair ships, then added free: Wildmark 02: The Second Rank, 128x128 RPG Character Sprites and Wildmark Actions 01: Strike, Hurt, Death, 128x128 & 64x64 action sprites. Their frames are being fixed first because we found the defects ourselves.

What a pack contains

Every pack sits in its own folder exactly as its own page delivers it: PNG frames and sheets at their native grid sizes (32x32 up to 256x256 across the library), its own Readme and its own licence. 50 packs carry Godot 4 SpriteFrames, 41 carry RPG Maker MZ sheets, 3 carry GameMaker files and three are pixel fonts with TrueType and BMFont files. Every pack works in any engine that reads PNG, including Unity and GameMaker. CATALOGUE.md lists every folder and its page.

Licence

You can use the sprites in commercial and personal games, as many projects as you like, with no royalty and no credit required, and edit them freely. You can't resell or share the sprites or fonts themselves as an asset pack, or use them to train a model. Each pack's own LICENSE.txt governs its folder.

The art in 55 of the 61 packs is generated with an AI pixel art model (PixelLab, on a paid plan that grants commercial use), then palette locked and checked by our own tooling. The three font packs, Emberwrit Skill Sets, Sparkfall 01 and Sparkfall 02 were drawn by code. The tooling was written with AI assistance.

Try before you buy

Free samplers from the same families: Mourncrest 00: 3 Free Undead Sprites [64x64], Farmstead 00: 4 Free Farm Bird Sprites [144 & 72 px], Wildmark Sampler: 4 Free Fantasy Hero Sprites [128 & 64 px], Hearthhands Sampler: 6 Free Villager Sprites [200 & 100 px], Kithfell Sampler: 3 Free Animal Sprites [128x128], Deepwarren Sampler: Free Giant Rat and Bat Monster Sprites.

Questions or a pack you want next: post a comment below. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

$19.99 now. The price rises as the library grows: $24.99 for new buyers at 64 packs, $29.99 at 67. Buyers keep every pack.

devlog.title: Sprite Library: Handheld 01 joins, 61 packs now
devlog.html:
Handheld 01 is now in the Sprite Library: 50 held weapons and tools drawn into the hands of the four Wildmark 01 heroes (elf, warrior, mage and rogue), in every frame of their idle and walk, in all 4 facings. The Library now holds 61 packs, worth $463.39 bought one by one, for $19.99. If you own it, download it again from your itch.io library: it is in wildmark-fantasy-heroes/handheld-equipment-overlay/.

  • Blades (7), axes and blunt (8), ranged (6), polearms and staves (7), magic (3), tools (13) and light and carried (6).
  • 11,200 overlay frames and 800 sheets at 128x128 and 64x64, laid out cell for cell like the Wildmark 01 sheets: stack the item on the hero and play the same frame. 400 Godot 4 SpriteFrames and a small script that keeps the item on the hero's frame and behind the body facing north.
  • Every item also ships alone (100 cells, the grip on the same pixel in each) for your own characters.

It is new here first: it has no page of its own yet, so for now the Library is the place to get it. Each item was drawn once by PixelLab, a generative AI pixel-art model, on a paid plan whose terms permit commercial use; PixelLab also read the hand position in each hero frame, and code places the drawing there by whole pixels, never redrawn or resampled.

The price rises as the library grows: $24.99 for new buyers at 64 packs, $29.99 at 67, each step announced here first. Anyone who already owns it keeps every pack that joins.

Every new CSAF sprite pack joins this page on its launch day, at no cost to anyone who owns it. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.
